verdict.rationale: Mastra ships its own testing surface, Studio. It runs locally at localhost:4111, or as a hosted visual environment, for testing agents, running workflows and inspecting traces, which gives a non-production place to exercise agents. Nothing documents isolating that environment from production data: no test-data fixtures, mock tools or staging separation are described. The code-mode 'isolated sandbox' is about computation isolation inside an agent run, not a test environment, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented separation of sandbox/test data from production data, mocking or stubbing of tools and external APIs during tests, environment-level configuration for staging versus production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Open Studio at [`http://localhost:4111`](http://localhost:4111) to test your agent and inspect its runs.
Studio: A hosted visual environment for testing agents and running workflows, plus inspecting traces
